name: Sculpfun iCube Pro Max 10W
tagline: 10W Compact enclosed Sculpfun : small footprint, full safety cabinet
tldr: Sculpfun iCube Pro Max 10W is the 10W SKU on the Sculpfun sculpfun icube pro line. Sculpfun's enclosed desktop laser for makers who want the brand's cutting performance in a safer cabinet. Verify optical power on the listing : do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

priceRange.note: 10W optical module : verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 10W Compact enclosed Sculpfun : small footprint, full safety cabinet
Fully enclosed cabinet : beam containment and smoke control vs open-frame diodes
Work area 300 × 300 mm on this chassis
10W on Sculpfun iCube Pro Max: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Reference engrave job on this module: ~12–18 min
Reference cut job on this module: ~6–10 min
cons: This module targets thin cuts (about 5 mm basswood class) : not thick production plywood
Not the SKU for a shop cutting 5 mm+ stock all day
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 10W module on Sculpfun iCube Pro Max. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.
